author: Tooth
body: I haven't played on Avicus in roughly a year, when I did I registered using my account "Tooth." I don't own it anymore so I was looking to register a new forums account under my new minecraft account, but it's giving me some trouble. I'm following the instructions correctly but keep getting messages like these: http://prntscr.com/hlh9lh & http://prntscr.com/hlh9pk I'm not sure if it's because I already have a registered account on here or something else.

title: I no longer own the account I registered with

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Hey Tooth.

Did you try connecting to the IP provided with the direct connect option in Minecraft? I'm not sure it makes a difference, but that's what I used when I recently set up my alt's account on the website last week.

If you already registered the account in the past, it should still work. It'll just reset your password once you've completed the registration steps, and you'll be able to log in again.

Let me know if you're still having issues after you try that out.
